title: Hono vs Elysia: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Hono vs Elysia: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: Hono's raw speed vs. Elysia's elegant context management.
• Latency: Minimal overhead in Hono vs. Elysia's V8 optimizations.
• Consistency: Predictable performance of Hono vs. Elysia's type safety.
• Failure Modes: Robustness of Hono's minimal API vs. Elysia's plugin ecosystem.
• Operational Overhead: Simplicity of Hono vs. Elysia's feature set.

Recommendation: For pure, unadulterated throughput and minimal overhead, Hono often takes the lead. Elysia shines when developer experience and type safety are paramount, offering impressive performance with added safety nets.
